notes: Selection boxes work like the CAD tab on both sides (left to right = wholly inside, right to left = touching). Add to slab side keeps the pieces as arranged on the pieces side, and seams that touch there open up for the saw: one blade (0.1875") on a black line, the miter gap (0.53", new Miter box) on a blue line. A blue outline shows which side you're working in; keys go to that side.
